decision.then: send Garry, through GBRA-108, a change to turn query's autocut default off (or floor it) for memory questions, with the paired numbers
no default change; tell GBRA-108 the quick look's 12-point drop came with the limit and passage changes
keep autocut on and close the lead

decision.if: a frontier reader closes the gap to README's 93.6% on off (point estimate at least 92.6% and Wilson interval including 93.6%)
decision.then: the gap was the reader: reader work goes ahead of retrieval work, starting with gbrain's own answer path on that reader

decision.if: both frontier readers fall short of 93.6% on off (interval upper end below it) and each one's oracle also falls short
decision.then: the one-shot answer prompt is the limit: reader-prompt work (a notes step) goes ahead of retrieval

decision.if: a frontier reader falls short on off but its oracle closes the gap and oracle minus off passes its Holm-adjusted test
decision.then: retrieval is the gap: retrieval work goes ahead of reader work, starting where off missed an answer turn

decision.if: any other reader-gap combination, or a result not distinguishable at this sample size
decision.then: no reordering of reader and retrieval work; the results name which rows were not distinguishable

decision.if: gpt-4o's task-averaged interval on off lies above, includes or lies below Redis's 86.14%
decision.then: README's comparison section gets a matched-harness row saying above, level or behind, with no ranking word; behind also gets a why-null pass
